text:
emily: Quick follow-up from today's multi-region sync. We landed failover behavior but ops asked for explicit language around escrowed writes / consented state before any auto-switchback. Need a short playbook + signals we can evaluate programmatically.

pavel: TL;DR: auto-switchback must pass (A) deterministic data catch-up and (B) residency/consent policy checks. For escrowed writes we also require an explicit escrow_clear flag from the control plane.

jena: From runtime we can provide these signals right now: kv.last_applied_seq{tenant,region}, kv.inflight_leases{tenant,region}, kv.ingress_queue_len{tenant,region}, kv.state_digest{tenant,region}. New addition: kv.escrowed_writes_count{tenant} which counts writes held for legal review. Auto-switchback requires escrowed_writes_count==0 and state_digest parity OR seq_delta<=1 for window.

legal: Clarification: "escrowed writes" here are writes that contain PII or third-party consent requirements. Control plane must expose tenant.policy_residency and tenant.escrow_state in {open,cleared,requires_review}. Only cleared allows auto-switchback. If requires_review -> manual only.

emily: Ops wants a single composite gauge for alerts: switchback.allowed{tenant,target_region}=1/0 with a reason label (caught_up,policy_block,escrow_open,inflight,drift,operator_lock). Emit counters switchback.attempts_total and switchback.blocked_reasons_total.

pavel: Implementation notes: add control plane flags: tenant.escrow_state, tenant.auto_switchback_mode={auto,manual,disabled}, tenant.switchback_cooldown_minutes. Default: tenants with residency_mode==hard or escrow_state!=cleared -> auto disabled. PLG tenants default to auto=true unless flagged.

jena: Sample event we can stream to logs/metrics pipeline so runs are reproducible (ops asked for exact payload):
```json
{
  "tenant_id":"acme-escrow",
  "ts":"2026-05-12T14:21:10Z",
  "primary":"us-east-1",
  "candidate":"eu-west-1",
  "seq_primary": 998234,
  "seq_candidate": 998233,
  "seq_delta": 1,
  "state_digest_primary":"5f4d...c3",
  "state_digest_candidate":"5f4d...c3",
  "escrowed_writes_count":0,
  "inflight_leases":0,
  "ingress_queue_len":0,
  "time_skew_ms":120,
  "policy_residency":"preferred",
  "escrow_state":"cleared",
  "switchback_allowed":true,
  "reason":"caught_up_and_escrow_cleared"
}
```

emily: Runbook (minimal snippet for SRE):
- Check tenant.policy_residency and tenant.escrow_state == "cleared"
- Confirm switchback.allowed == 1 for >=60s
- Confirm kv.inflight_leases==0 and kv.ingress_queue_len==0
- Optionally verify state_digest parity or seq_delta <= 1 for 60s
- Execute short deterministic canary (3 read/writes) and compare digests
- Flip primary, set tenant.switchback_cooldown_until = now + tenant.switchback_cooldown_minutes
- Monitor error rate and tail latency for 10m; revert if error rate > 2% or digest mismatch observed

ops-bot: notice: failover observed tenant=acme-escrow at 2026-05-12T14:17:01Z, duration=7m, seq_delta=2, escrowed_writes_count=3 -> auto-switchback blocked (reason=escrow_open)

jena: CLI emergency override for enterprise (requires audit & legal signoff):
```bash
redwoodctl tenant switchback --tenant acme-escrow --target-region eu-west-1 --force-override --ticket TKT-789 --approval "legal:567"
```
Note: --force-override logs audit entry and is limited to support-admin role.

pavel: To avoid flapping, if switchback fails or is reverted, set tenant.auto_switchback_mode = manual for 1h and notify legal/ops. Also emit switchback.revert_count per-tenant.

emily: Owners: runtime=jena, controlplane=pavel, ops=emily, legal=legal. Target: PLG canary next Thursday. I'll open the runbook PR with the JSON example. Thanks all :thumbsup:
